backgrounds: A single set: a warm, dated American home kitchen at night, shot from one fixed wide camera angle. Wood-toned upper and lower cabinets line the back wall, a white/cream freestanding gas range with a hood sits center, a stainless double-door refrigerator anchors the far left, and a sink/counter run with a window looking out on a lit night-time city skyline anchors the right. A ceiling pendant lamp lights the room warmly against the cool blue night outside the window. No location changes occur across the video; only the framing changes (wide two-shot vs. tighter single-character close-ups on the wife or husband).

lighting_notes: Warm, motivated interior lighting from a single overhead pendant lamp creates soft warm highlights on the characters and cabinetry, contrasted with a cool blue exterior visible through the window, giving a classic 'warm kitchen at night' sitcom feel. Lighting is even and naturalistic (no dramatic shadows), keeping focus on facial performance rather than mood lighting.
color_palette: cool navy blue (night sky through window)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is a dense, detailed, realistic stop-motion kitchen (textured felt/fabric character surfaces, many small background props like bottles, dish rack, knife block) rather than a stylized flat backdrop, but the camera stays locked on one static wide shot with minimal blocking. The visual busyness reads as deliberate real-world grounding for a mundane domestic sitcom moment, while the fixed single angle keeps compositional complexity low so the comedy stays centered on the two characters' expressions and dialogue.
